To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the leadership(s) in early childhood education can be understood as an assemblage of different components that are constantly in motion.
leadership is a process of becoming, and it can be understood through the notion of assemblage.
the leadership(s) of early childhood education is a process of thinking and becoming.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how we can understand the leadership in ECE in a different way.
how we can think together with Deleuzian philosophy in order to create new understandings of the temporality of leadership.
the question: how does thinking and becoming leadership(s) in early childhood education relate to the notion of temporality?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this conceptualization can offer a new understanding of leadership in ECE, and in education generally.

the leadership(s) in early childhood education is not only a matter of individual effectiveness but also a question of how the individual leader becomes the leadership(s) through the assemblage of the teacher and leader.

the concept of Body/Voices without Organs is a promising way of conceptualizing educational leadership and that the notion of leadership assemblage is a useful way of understanding educational leaders’ work and the work of ECE teacher leaders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
leadership is an assemblage that is constantly becoming, and that it is always already in a process of becoming, and therefore is never complete.
the leadership assemblage is a concept for thinking and becoming the leadership(s) of ECE.
leadership is a process that is constantly in motion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
leadership can be thought of as an assemblage that emerges through a series of events.
we should not only look at leadership as an individual, but also as a process of becoming and a process of thinking and acting together.
leadership is not something that can be done by one person, but rather something that is done together with the people that are being led.
